title: Pre-production
description: Professional pre-production: research, scripting, planning, casting, locations, schedules, and risk control before cameras roll.
summary: Pre-production is the planning phase that converts a creative brief into executable schedules, shot/scene plans, budgets, and risk controls before capture begins.
